Homepage-derived material:
The native renderer and widget catalog derive from gethomepage/homepage
v2.6.0, commit 51cc1684f9f34a7877ed462b8f94c9cc687b4dde. Retain upstream
copyright and GPL-3.0 terms; see homepage-LICENSE. Source preparation fetches
and verifies the exact upstream archive before applying the Studio overlay.
Studio's original-code license does not broaden the upstream grant.
The catalog preserves source attribution and documentation example notices;
see catalog-NOTICE.txt. It is a catalog of native examples and known fields,
not a complete configuration schema or universal integration test.

YAML parser:
yaml 2.8.3 by Eemeli Aro is licensed under ISC. The exact installed notice is
preserved in yaml-LICENSE. Keep dependency notices in corresponding-source
and distribution artifacts.
